subject: environment
note: Original environment pack: school chapters plus GS-III law, conventions, India and Bihar. Use with the Science and Geography NCERT paths.

chapters.title: Garbage and 3Rs
chapters.summary: Segregation, composting, plastic persistence. Habit plus municipal systems.

chapters.title: Water as a resource
chapters.summary: Cycle, scarcity, flood and drought in the same country. Conservation is culture plus engineering.

chapters.title: Forests as lifeline
chapters.summary: Layers, tribes, products, deforestation chain (soil, climate, livelihoods).

chapters.title: Wastewater and sanitation
chapters.summary: Sewage treatment, open defecation free as a public-health project, river pollution.

chapters.title: Coal, petroleum and combustion
chapters.summary: Finite fossils, incomplete combustion, soot, CO. Energy transition starts as a science fact.

chapters.title: Conservation of plants and animals
chapters.summary: Protected area network, endemic species, Red Data, migratory birds. Paper parks vs real protection.

chapters.title: Air and water pollution
chapters.summary: Smog, acid rain, greenhouse, industrial and domestic effluent. Ganga as a living case.

chapters.title: Biogeochemical cycles
chapters.summary: Water, nitrogen, carbon, oxygen. Human disruption (fertiliser, fossil carbon) is the GS hook.

chapters.title: Ozone and greenhouse
chapters.summary: Stratospheric ozone vs tropospheric warming — do not mix the two. Montreal vs UNFCCC.

chapters.title: Ecosystems and food chains
chapters.summary: Producers to decomposers, 10% law, biomagnification (DDT). Why top predators are few.

chapters.title: Sustainable resource management
chapters.summary: Stakeholders in forests and dams. Chipko and local institutions. 5Rs.

chapters.title: Ecology basics for Prelims
chapters.summary: Biome, ecotone, niche, keystone, edge effect, ecological succession, pyramids (number, biomass, energy).

chapters.title: Biodiversity of India
chapters.summary: Four hotspots touching India, biogeographic zones, Western Ghats vs Himalaya, Indo-Burma, Sundaland. Species examples without stuffing 200 names.

chapters.title: Protected area architecture
chapters.summary: NP, WLS, conservation/community reserves, biosphere, Ramsar, World Heritage, tiger reserves, elephant corridors.

chapters.title: Pollution science
chapters.summary: Air (PM, NOx, SOx, ozone), water (BOD/COD idea), soil, noise, plastic, e-waste, biomedical. NCAP, CPCB, SPCBs.

chapters.title: Climate change science
chapters.summary: GHG, GWP, carbon budget, 1.5°C, adaptation vs mitigation, India’s energy mix, just transition.

chapters.title: Indian environmental law stack
chapters.summary: 1972 Stockholm → Wildlife Act 1972, Water 1974, Forest 1980, Air 1981, EPA 1986 umbrella, Biodiversity 2002, FRA 2006, NGT 2010. EIA notification as the live wire.

chapters.title: Forest Rights and people
chapters.summary: FRA, Gram Sabha, critical wildlife habitat tension. Conservation that ignores people fails; people without ecology also fail.

chapters.title: Conventions one-pass
chapters.summary: UNFCCC/Kyoto/Paris, CBD, CITES, Ramsar, CMS, Bonn, Basel, Rotterdam, Stockholm, Minamata, UNCCD, Montreal/Kigali.

chapters.title: Disaster–environment in Bihar
chapters.summary: Floods, heat, changing monsoon, embankment ecology, arsenic, river-linking debates. Adaptation is the Bihar climate story.

chapters.title: Agriculture and environment
chapters.summary: Stubble, fertiliser runoff, groundwater, agroforestry, millet, organic. Green Revolution’s ecological bill.

chapters.title: Energy transition
chapters.summary: Coal dependence, RE targets, grid, storage, green hydrogen hype vs logistics, nuclear. Security + climate + jobs.
